name: loadout-codex
description: Prompt routing and library search for Codex CLI. Requires loadout on PATH and Node 22.12+. Each routed prompt, with the repository's top-level file names and dependency names, goes to TypeSafe's Jev API, and so do the agent's find_tools goals and keywords, with file names from the folder the host starts the server in; setting "router": "lexical" keeps prompts local. Trust the hook in /hooks after installation.
